thresholds.olfactory_manifestation: Intermittent faint odor when facing Shiki close up: stagnant medical room and damp stone; never a long-range locator.
thresholds.psychological_impression: At recognized close presence, unease sometimes acquires an inexpressible sense that something will die slowly and painfully. No autonomic fear attack.

thresholds.label: Бледность
thresholds.manifestation: Gradual sustained skin paleness, beginning darkening of under-eye skin and slight hollowing visible only on close inspection; still NO contact-transmission ability. No itching, fever, altered pain/taste or pathologic body heat. Layered unnatural scent begins as approved at previous stage.

thresholds.psychological_impression: During actual proximity or interaction, occasional visceral foreboding of choking, agony and a protracted end, individual NPC reactions. No automatic panic.

thresholds.label: Истощённый силуэт

thresholds.olfactory_manifestation: At conversational arm's length, an identifiable but restrained scent: stale hospital air, wet earth and a faint organic decay note, with distant metallic or medicinal undertones. Near Shiki while noticed; no persistent airborne plume or scent trail. Coexists with, and is secondary to, the stronger death-agony foreboding.
thresholds.psychological_impression: Current stage: a restrained, psychologically uncanny conviction, for some NPCs, that lingering sick agony and approaching death are somehow close. Express through their body language and personal history, never universal fear.

thresholds.label: Чёрные сосуды
thresholds.manifestation: Deepened nonreversible gaunt/pale shape, prominent dark superficial vessels at neck/trunk, visual ink roots may reach NECK but NEVER FACE. STILL no harmful skin-to-skin transmission until stage 5. No fever, taste/pain loss or abnormal heat. Unusual cold-mineral smoke scent develops at stage-appropriate intensity.

thresholds.psychological_impression: As outward pallor and vessel marks progress, perceived closeness may intensify dread of a slow painful death; depends on who notices and context.

thresholds.label: Активный контактный синдром

thresholds.olfactory_manifestation: In direct close quarters the same signature is recognizable; it does not transmit disease via smell. Stage5 bare-living-skin-contact hazard remains separate.
thresholds.psychological_impression: Dread as before plus separately gated possible bare-skin contact illness; emotional signal itself never transmits disease or acts as genjutsu.

thresholds.label: Устойчивая тяжёлая форма
thresholds.manifestation: Permanent conspicuous gauntness, dark hollows and vessels, extended roots on neck/trunk but never FACE; the same skin-contact-only hazard continues. NO fixed disease symptoms beyond approved phenotype, no stat nerf, no preordained terminal collapse.
thresholds.olfactory_manifestation: More distinct during direct close encounters, never a spreading cloud or persistent following trail; still no infectious aerosol or spontaneous tissue rot.
thresholds.psychological_impression: Presence can inspire sharper associations of helpless, prolonged dying in those who clearly see/interact with him, with autonomous varied responses.
